# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m159 engine update**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adopts Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements. WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 9 or later; non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets, and their build targets reject unsupported WebAssembly frameworks. Retarget WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later and use the matching native archives: .NET 9/10 use Emscripten 3.1.56, while .NET 11+ use 6.0.2. Archives are not interchangeable across these toolchains. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged. ([#5700](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5700))

## Engine

- **Skia m159** — Updates the native renderer with WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and image and rendering correctness fixes. C API exports and public managed signatures are unchanged. ([#5685](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5685))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 9 or later, with runtime-matched archives retained for supported toolchains. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.
